description: Configurable status line below or above the composer: model, context, usage limits, cost, Git, pull request and CI status, and your own scripts

placement.title: Position
placement.description: Show the status line below or above the prompt

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: compact or detailed segment sets; custom uses the Custom layout setting

layout.default: model effort tier provider context tokens cache cost limits; git changes pr ci session tools agents plan omd
layout.title: Custom layout
layout.description: Segment IDs separated by spaces, lines by ; (up to 4 lines); used when Preset is custom

hidden.title: Hidden segments
hidden.description: Segment IDs to hide from the chosen preset, separated by spaces

glyphs.title: Symbols
glyphs.description: unicode symbols, or plain ascii characters

bars.title: Progress bars
bars.description: Draw a bar before the context percentage

thresholds.title: Warning levels
thresholds.description: When segments turn to warning and alert: percent for context and limits, USD for cost

tones.title: Colors
tones.description: Per-segment color overrides as segment=tone: accent, success, attention, failure, muted, normal

github.title: GitHub status
github.description: Show pull request and CI segments once a GitHub token is connected

refresh_s.title: Git refresh
refresh_s.description: Seconds between git status refreshes (5 to 3,600)

scripts.title: Custom segments
scripts.description: A JSON array of your own segments; see the mod's README
